chunks: I call to witness the sky, the one having the constellations.
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Dhat al-Buruj' refer to in Surah Al-Buruj?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this oath underscores the divine order (nizam) of the cosmos as a testament to the Creator's power, contrasting the eternal stability of the heavens with the transient persecution of the believers in the Trench. The mention of 'Buruj' (constellations) highlights the precision of celestial movements, serving as a sign for those who reflect on the resurrection and divine justice.
